technical_summary.technical_limit: Closed topology, contact, and exposure do not establish correct anatomy or acceptable visible intersections. Those are separately adjudicated in visual/factual/specification.

reference_concept_visual_review.reference: Noailles et al. 2014, pp. 454–455 and 462–465, Fig. 5. Inspected original cast panel pixels and their scale/caption. Selected Letna D. barrandei has smoother, less lobate plates; no hyperadult D. sedgwicki rosette ornament is imported. One brachiole and separate differentiated homoiostele are consistent.
reference_concept_visual_review.concept: Genuine concept is thicker with relatively long brachiole and insufficient tail differentiation. Frozen correction produces visibly flatter theca, shorter unbranched brachiole and differentiated broad proximal/narrow distal stem.
reference_concept_visual_review.visual: All eight frames, sheet and exact detail inspected. Plate seams, single small suranal projection, thin full-volume theca, short brachiole and much longer ringed homoiostele read. End-on front/rear are small because fixed whole-specimen framing is dominated by stem; side/top/detail resolve the needed anatomy. No floating roots or conspicuous exposed overlap observed.

trochocystites.outcome_scope: Fresh independent static-stylized review only. Not GPU/composed-scene certification, publication approval, release, or counter increment.

technical_summary.technical_limit: Closed topology, contact, and exposure do not establish correct anatomy or acceptable visible intersections. Those are separately adjudicated in visual/factual/specification.

reference_concept_visual_review.reference: Lefebvre et al. 2024 p. 439 Fig. 1A, actual NMP.L9060 fossil photograph and caption inspected. The complete homostele is absent in that photo; its reconstruction is supported by comparative primary text. Smith & Zamora 2009 publisher-indexed text explicitly distinguishes stout marginal ossicles from small tessellate internal integument plates. Their caption identifies NMP9060 dorsal and NMP9066 lectotype ventral; the conflicting 2024 lectotype label is left unresolved. Rahman et al. 2020 primary methods/discussion read for reconstructed anatomy and short stele/ventral stabilization, not used as fossil pixels or copied mesh.
reference_concept_visual_review.concept: Genuine concept has fine interior pavement and broad plated frame. Frozen correction calls for a right anterolateral mouth and real unequal gutters. Final preserves the frame/short stele but loses the smaller-pavement contrast and has crossing groove ends at its mouth.
reference_concept_visual_review.visual: All eight frames, sheet and exact detail inspected. Top, hero, reversehero and detail show overly broad interior polygons. Two further exact-GLB close-ups show groove bodies passing through the oral ring/opening. Front/side verify thin body and short posterior stele. These are visible geometric/anatomical defects, not a chosen palette or nominal absolute size objection.

findings.finding: Dominant central thecal pavement plates are visibly larger than marginal cinctus plates, reversing the original smaller-pavement distinction.
findings.frozen_requirement: Flattened asymmetric oval/pear-shaped theca, a thick individually plated cinctus and smaller irregular thecal pavement.
findings.primary_basis: Actual NMP.L9060 pixels in Lefebvre2024 Fig.1A and small tessellate integument versus stout marginal ossicles in Smith & Zamora2009 primary text.

measurement.qualification: Area measurement describes observed reversal of relative pavement/frame scale. No exact plate-count or arbitrary numeric threshold introduced.

findings.minimum_repair: Refine/repartition only the thecal pavement into visibly smaller, irregular plates while retaining the existing marginal frame, body, stele, and gross dimensions. No exact plate count, mm size, or ratio threshold is imposed.

findings.finding: The left and right groove solids cross through the oral ring and visibly bridge/obstruct its opening. Intersection alone established attachment but did not establish a correct anatomical junction.
findings.measurement: The mouth-normal floor-center ray meets groove_right 0.00031727 m above the floor; multiple nearby rays also meet the grooves. Fresh exact-subject normal and oblique images visibly confirm the crossing, so this is not a numerical-only rejection.
findings.minimum_repair: Reroute/trim the terminal groove bodies to meet the appropriate oral perimeter without spanning through its center; preserve unequal real gutters, right anterolateral location, closed outward solids, strict base contact, and a readable recessed opening.

minimum_affected_repair_scope: Refine/repartition only the thecal pavement into visibly smaller, irregular plates while retaining the existing marginal frame, body, stele, and gross dimensions. No exact plate count, mm size, or ratio threshold is imposed.

helicoplacus.outcome_scope: Fresh independent static-stylized review only. Not GPU/composed-scene certification, publication approval, release, or counter increment.

technical_summary.technical_limit: Closed topology, contact, and exposure do not establish correct anatomy or acceptable visible intersections. Those are separately adjudicated in visual/factual/specification.

reference_concept_visual_review.reference: Sprinkle & Wilbur 2005 pp. 281–285 and Fig. 1D inspected from the retained PDF misleadingly named 2006. Fig. 1D is a latex/silicone cast of H. everndeni LACMNH17529, not Waucobella in panel B. Primary 2006 publisher abstract/introduction/systematic excerpts independently retrieved; synonymy under H. gilberti is supported, but full 2006 text is not claimed read. Three ambulacral paths meet at a lateral mouth; shell rows are left-handed. Anal position remains unresolved and no invented anal pyramid was added.
reference_concept_visual_review.concept: Genuine concept has overly longitudinal bands. Final geometry corrects them to true left-handed oblique plate rows and three winding paths ending away from poles. No five-ray Helicocystis-like crown.
reference_concept_visual_review.visual: All eight frames, sheet and exact detail inspected. Upright faceted spindle, narrow helical paths, shell segmentation and lateral mouth location are clear. Two further exact-GLB mouth views reveal an ambulacral strip bridging straight across the oral cavity and shell plates intruding into the recess. Required junction needs local cleanup; body outline, handedness and path count need no redesign.

findings.finding: An ambulacral cover-plate strip passes across the lateral oral opening, while underlying helical plates intrude into the recess. This presents an intersecting band through a ring, rather than a clean three-path oral junction.
findings.primary_basis: Original frozen requirement: exactly three narrow paths, two upper and one lower, meet at a lateral mouth. Sprinkle & Wilbur2005 supports the lateral junction; no new requirement for internal biological anatomy is added.
findings.measurement: Local-normal floor probes detect some underlying helical plating; other probes are unobstructed through the narrow strip gap. Those finite ray proportions are not used as pass/fail thresholds. Fresh exact-GLB normal/oblique pixels independently show the strip across the opening.
findings.minimum_repair: Clean up only the mouth/ambulacral terminal junction and local shell clearance. The three surface paths should terminate into the oral perimeter without a band bridging the aperture. Retain the left-handed shell, three-path count, lateral position, body shape, and before-pole endpoints.

minimum_affected_repair_scope: Clean up only the mouth/ambulacral terminal junction and local shell clearance. The three surface paths should terminate into the oral perimeter without a band bridging the aperture. Retain the left-handed shell, three-path count, lateral position, body shape, and before-pole endpoints.

reference_concept_visual_review.reference: Smith 1985 pp. 736–740 and plate 87 inspected visually: BM(NH)E16004 panels 1/2/5 and E63138 panel 6 are latex casts. Text supports a fully plated low subpentagonal body, narrow surface ambulacra, proximal 2–1–2 arrangement and noncentral periproct. Zamora et al. 2015 publisher abstract/introduction/systematic excerpts support S. flexibilis synonymy and aboral attachment; no full-text access claim.
reference_concept_visual_review.concept: Genuine concept is too thick and its ambulacra too broad. Final visibly corrects both with a continuous low disc, five narrow surface bands and broad plated interambulacra.
reference_concept_visual_review.visual: All eight frames, sheet and exact detail inspected. Five bands remain on a continuous rounded-subpentagonal low disc, with no projecting starfish arms. Mouth and offset periproct are readable. Side/front/rear show plated underside and small central attachment pad; final separate aboral view additionally checked.
